name: InkRoom
tagline: Generate and edit AI images with cost previews and original-image recovery
description: Hosted InkRoom MCP for image generation, reference-image editing, server-managed batches, model comparison and image processing. Requires each user's own InkRoom account and Bearer MCP Token. Generation is charged to that user's credits under their saved authorization; quotes, approval, original receipts and settlement remain visible. The repository path provides client setup documentation, not hosted server source.

env.name: INKROOM_MCP_TOKEN
env.description: Your personal InkRoom MCP Token, without the Bearer prefix. Never use a shared publisher Token.

install.notes: Use your own Token privately in the Authorization header. Preserve existing MCP configuration. Verify tool discovery and a read-only help call; installation does not grant image credits. Do not paste a literal ${INKROOM_MCP_TOKEN} into settings: substitute it through your private environment or configure it in Cline. See the repository README for the explicit streamableHttp configuration.
